thread:
maria_g: thinking about the exporter duplication problem when we move to per-tenant pipelines. worried about egress cost and memory.
alex_s: +1, do we have numbers on duplicate batches per-exporter? rough estimate?
jon_w: rough: if every tenant has a local span pipeline and each pipeline fans out to 2 exporters, we multiply in-flight batches. memory = O(tenants * batch_size)
sara_p: also backpressure: if one exporter is slow, the agent queues per-pipeline and OOMs. gateway helps centralize and apply flow control.
maria_g: gateway centralizes but it also increases inter-region egress and higher tail latency for local devs. tradeoffs.
alex_s: proposal: hybrid. agent collects and does basic batching + sampling, gateway does tenant-aware dedupe + long-term retention exporters.
jon_w: hybrid sounds ok. we still need a clear definition of which exporters live where. e.g. short-term APM sink -> agent, long-term cold storage -> gateway.
sara_p: UX implication: Console should show "pipeline affinity" per-exporter and a cost estimate toggle. PM asked for per-route cost projection.
maria_g: agreed. for retention we need a canonical policy enforcement point. gateway can enforce retention TTLs and trigger async compaction.
alex_s: implementation idea: tag spans with pipeline_origin and tenant_id, then gateway can coalesce by tenant and apply retention/replication rules.
jon_w: pseudo-config I sketched:
```
pipelines:
  tenant_local:
    receiver: otlp
    exporters: [apm_local]
    processors: [batch, sampling]
  gateway_forward:
    receiver: grpc
    exporters: [longterm_s3, metrics_sink]
    processors: [dedupe, tenant_filter]
routing:
  - match: tenant_id =~ /enterprise-.*/
    route: gateway_forward
```

sara_p: nice. questions: how do we avoid double-exporting when agent and gateway both ship to same s3 bucket? need idempotency keys or dedupe at gateway.
maria_g: yes, add export_id + span_hash metadata. gateway dedupe processor compares hashes and drops duplicates within window.
ops-bot: deployment note: rolling out dedupe requires a brief window where both dedupe-off and dedupe-on are accepted; we should include a TTL header for backcompat.
alex_s: also quota model: we should charge egress per-exporter and show consolidated view. Console change: per-exporter and per-tenant breakdown + projected monthly cost.
jon_w: testing: run a soak with 10k tenants, 1k RPS, enable sampling variations. watch memory and queue depth.
sara_p: I'll add a dashboard: collector-queues, exporter-latency-p50/p95, dedupe-hits, duplicate_drop_rate.
maria_g: ok action items: (1) prototype gateway dedupe processor (2) instrument export_id/span_hash (3) console cost toggle + dashboard (4) load test plan + runlist.
alex_s: I'll put up a short ADR draft for the hybrid model and include cost/latency numbers.
jon_w: thumbs up. ping me when ADR is up, I can help with perf numbers.
sara_p: tagging @alex_s for ADR.
maria_g: thanks all :thumbsup:
